data.name: Rahma
data.gender_notes: Rahma is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ر-ح-م (r-ḥ-m), 'to have mercy'. Raḥma means 'mercy, compassion'. Its root is ر-ح-م (r-ḥ-m). A Qur'anic concept; the Prophet ﷺ is called raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn. Rahma is a Arabic name meaning “Mercy; compassion”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rahma expresses “Mercy; compassion”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ر-ح-م (r-ḥ-m), 'to have mercy'. Raḥma means 'mercy, compassion'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahma total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
